messages:
Maya (SRE): FYI from the outage postmortem — one thing keeps coming up: we waste a lot of time triaging customer impact vs engineering cause. Thinking out loud: can we make the incident flow include a short customer-impact curation step that the bot prompts for during the page and at handoff?

Aj Patel: Love that. Right now the bot only creates an incident doc and assigns owner. If it can capture a structured impact summary (customers affected, degradation type, P0/P1 impact), follow-ups would be much quicker.

Samir K: +1. We tried ad-hoc tags in the last incident but they were inconsistent. A small form or quick checklist would help. Example fields: `impact_scope`, `percent_users`, `downtime_estimate`, `customer_contacts`.

Jen H: Can the bot auto-suggest values? E.g. infer `percent_users` from error rate spike + traffic window. Even if it's a guess, it speeds up handoff.

Maya (SRE): Exactly. Minimal prompts during mitigation, then a required confirmation during handoff. Bot should also create the postmortem skeleton and schedule the first follow-up meeting.

Luca (PM): From product side — please include a quick "customer-facing summary" snippet we can copy to status pages. Needs to be short (1-2 sentences) and editable.

Aj Patel: Sketching an example flow:
```
# incident bot flow (proposal)
- page -> oncall acknowledges
- bot prompts: 3 quick fields (impact, estimated scope, customer-facing line)
- bot logs answers to incident doc (confluence/incidents)
- at incident close, bot schedules 30/90 day followups + creates postmortem draft
```

Samir K: We should add an action-item tracker link in the incident doc that maps to our action dashboard. Want to avoid scattered TODOs. The bot can create the action list with status=Open.

Jen H: UI idea: have the bot post a one-line `actions: <link>` message that includes a small table preview. Example: `| owner | action | due | status |'`

oncall-bot: Scheduling follow-up: created postmortem draft at https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2001 and scheduled "Postmortem Review" for 2026-04-02 10:00 UTC.

Maya (SRE): Nice — can we make those dates configurable per sev? E.g. P1 follow-ups in 7 days, P2 in 14. Also different owners auto-assigned: SRE lead + product PM.

Aj Patel: Proto-config YAML I mocked for the bot (could be in repo `infra/incident-bot/config.yaml`):
```
postmortem:
  schedule:
    P0: [2, 30]
    P1: [7, 30]
    P2: [14]
  required_fields: [impact_scope, customer_snippet, root_area]
actions:
  create_tracker: true
  default_status: Open
```

Samir K: For automation safety, bot should be able to "suggest" content but not publish the customer-facing snippet without a human confirmation. Also add a quick `/incident edit-snippet` command.

Jen H: Ops question — what's the minimal friction for oncall to fill the form during pager storm? If it's >30s people won't do it. Maybe allow `skip` and the bot will auto-fill best-effort and mark as `needs_review` for handoff.

Maya (SRE): Agreed. `skip` with `needs_review` is the right balance. Also add an opt-in voice note link for post-incident quick context (short recorded clip stored on S3).

Luca (PM): We should wire postmortem actions to the product roadmap board (Jira) as epics if severity > P1. Bot could create a ticket template.

Aj Patel: Proposed minimal MVP scope: 1) Add 3 quick fields to paging flow, 2) create postmortem draft + actions list, 3) schedule review meeting. Keep auto-todo creation behind a feature flag.

Samir K: I'll take the MVP implementation (infra side) if someone owns the product snippet + config details.

Maya (SRE): I'll own acceptance criteria and handoff flow. Jen, can you own the customer-facing copy template?

Jen H: Yeah I can take that. Will write two templates: "status page" and "customer email".

oncall-bot: Action created: `INC-2001: create action tracker` assigned to Samir K (due 2026-03-12). Reaction: :white_check_mark:

Maya (SRE): Cool. Next steps: Samir to prototype bot changes (PR->infra repo), Jen to add templates, Aj to add config YAML, Maya to write acceptance tests. We'll regroup in #eng-oncall in ~1 week to review.

Luca (PM): One more ask — can we add a lightweight analytics event when the bot auto-fills vs human fills, so we can measure adoption and friction?

Aj Patel: Good call. I'll add analytics hooks to the flow.

Maya (SRE): Thanks all. If anyone wants to join the proto sync ping me or drop a :eyes: below.

Jen H: :eyes:

Samir K: I'll open the PR by EOD tomorrow with the stub endpoints and config.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled review meeting for INC-2001 on 2026-04-02 10:00 UTC. Attendees: Maya (SRE), Samir K, Aj Patel, Jen H, Luca (PM).
